maker.name: Huano
maker.about: Huano is the brand of Huizhou Huannuo Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. (惠州市环诺电子科技有限公司), founded in 2014, which began mass-producing mechanical keyboard switches in 2015 and also makes mouse micro switches, encoders and tact switches. It moved its factory from Dongguan to Yuanzhou, Huizhou in 2020.

reviews.verdict: Consistent, smooth, muted factory-lubed linear; the reviewer calls it shockingly good for about $0.30 per switch.
